events.name: Parrotfish
events.info: The Moroccan Lounge presents: Parrotfish with support from Trash Day & Lucky Me [October 9, 2026 / Doors 9:30pm / $15 adv / $18 dos / All Ages] With tens of millions of streams, hundreds of thousands of monthly listeners, and a rapidly growing online following, Parrotfish is quickly becoming one of the most lovable oddballs in alternative rock. The band has left a trail of sweaty festival sets, high-profile direct support slots, and sold-out headline shows across North America. Their high-octane live show blends funk- rock riffs, three-part harmonies, and infectious on-stage chemistry that turns first-time listeners into full-blown lifers.
events.pleaseNote: The Moroccan Lounge is a cashless venue. Please plan accordingly. We are located at 901 1st St, Los Angeles, CA 90012. For any ADA accommodations please email us at info@themoroccan.com. For all other information please visit themoroccan.com
